summary: Continued the decision-formation axis after the configuration-visibility result and recorded a source-only account of commit eligibility: the commitment match set is built only from Voter entries (newCommitment, setConfiguration), match() drops any server ID absent from that map, and recalculate derives commitIndex solely from those values, while replication goroutines exist for every configured server and quorumSize/checkLeaderLease count only Voters, so a Nonvoter/Staging acknowledgement cannot advance commitIndex or reach the FSM. Added the new investigation @q_nonvoter_commit with a mixed-suffrage discriminator, promoted the Fact @k_voter_only_commit, and interpreted it as explained with no defect asserted (source-only). Also ran a race-enabled subset of the snapshot's own tests over configuration-change and leadership-transfer paths (TestRaft_LeadershipTransfer, AddVoter/AddNonvoter/DemoteVoter/RemoveServer, LeaderLease, ConfigChange) with no data race and no failure.
